app.name: Business Training Portal
app.nameThai: พอร์ทัลฝึกอบรมธุรกิจ

home.title: Thailand Business Training & Bank Verification Portal
home.description: Prepare for your company's bank account verification. Study your own DBD certificate, practise with quizzes, pass the exam, and rehearse the interview with a simulated bank officer.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.hint: Use the login ID and password from your administrator.
auth.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Please contact your administrator.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noCompany: No company has been assigned to you yet. Please contact your administrator.

appointment.pending: Eligibility date pending — the certificate issue date is missing.

next.study: Your next step is the study material. Read the cards about your company before the quiz.
next.quiz: Your next step is the evaluation quiz. It shows what to review before the exam.
next.exam: Your next step is the exam. Passing it unlocks the readiness interview.
next.nameCard: Your next step is the name card. Create it before the readiness interview.
next.interview: Your next step is the readiness interview. The officer asks about your company, in Thai.
next.appointment: You are ready. Your next step is the bank appointment.
next.done: You have completed every step. Well done.

users.title: Create learner & DBD
users.company: Company (the DBD record the learner studies)
users.companyHint: The learner's study material, questions and bank date come from this company's DBD record. Only confirmed records can be chosen.
users.noConfirmedCompany: No confirmed DBD record yet — confirm the company’s record before creating a learner.
users.noManager: Create a manager first — every learner belongs to a team.
users.newIntro: Give the learner a login ID, a password, their name and contact details, and the confirmed company they study.

errors.phone: Enter a Thai mobile number, e.g. 081-234-5678
errors.website: Enter a web address, e.g. example.co.th
errors.facebookPage: Enter the page name or its facebook.com link

version.title: Training version
version.none: No version pinned yet — the company's facts are not versioned.
version.current: This is the company's current version.
version.moveHint: From now on the learner studies and is evaluated on this version. Refused while a quiz, exam or interview is in progress.
version.roleUnconfirmed: The role is not confirmed: the learner's own concepts do not count until it is.

errors.evaluation-in-progress: A quiz, exam or interview is in progress; try again when it is finished.
errors.not-active: That is not the company's current version.
errors.other-record: That version belongs to another company.
errors.no-version: The company has no version yet.
errors.role-missing: Write the learner's name as in the DBD documents first.

learners.title: Learner Record
learners.intro: Every learner your team is training: their company, MCQ and Chatbot results, and appointment. To add a learner, go to

createDbd.title: Create DBD
createDbd.intro: Upload the company’s DBD documents and give the four details below. The documents are read and indexed in the background (1–3 minutes); when every fact is found, the company confirms itself and can be given to a learner.
createDbd.introNoReader: Upload the company’s DBD documents and give the four details below. Automatic reading is not set up here, so open the company afterwards to fill it in and confirm it.
createDbd.byHand: Enter a company by hand instead
createDbd.created: Uploaded. The documents are being read — the company is listed below and confirms itself when everything is found.
createDbd.createdNoReader: Uploaded. Open the company below to fill it in and confirm it.

loginIdField.label: Login ID
loginIdField.hint: 2–6 letters or numbers. A free code is filled in — keep it, press ↻ for another, or type your own.
loginIdField.taken: This login ID is already taken — choose another
loginIdField.noTeam: This team cannot take new learners

dbd.title: DBD records
dbd.dateHint: As printed on the certificate, e.g. 9 เมษายน 2569, 09/04/2569 or 9 April 2026
dbd.directorsHint: One director per line: Thai name | English name

errors.upload-failed: The file could not be uploaded (connection lost or not a PDF). Please try again.
errors.invalid-file: Only PDF files up to 30 MB are accepted (6 files at most)
errors.answers-required: Cannot save: this record is confirmed, so its contact and business answers must be complete first (see below).

dbd.extracted: Extraction complete — review the suggested values below, then save and confirm.
dbd.extractHint: Reads the uploaded certificate again and fills only fields that are still empty.
dbd.extractionNotConfigured: AI extraction is not configured (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
dbd.reviewSuggestions: Suggested values from the certificate are shown where the record is still empty. Check every field — especially highlighted ones — then Save and Confirm.

extractErrors.provider: The extraction service failed. Try again later.
extractErrors.invalid_output: The extraction result was not usable.
extractErrors.too_large: The documents exceed 30 MB in total; split or compress them

dbd.uploadFirstHint: Choose the Thai PDFs (several at once: certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2). The documents are read and all three levels are filled in automatically; you then review, correct if needed, and confirm.
dbd.uploadFirstNoExtraction: Document reading is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). The file is stored and you fill in the fields below yourself.
dbd.uploadFillsHint: Add more DBD documents (certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2); every file is read and only empty fields are filled.
dbd.orEnterManually: Or enter the details manually without a file
dbd.uploadedButNotRead: The file was uploaded but could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or try reading again.

levels.business: Level 2 — Business profile (objectives sheet / Bor.Or.Jor.5 / Bor.Or.Jor.2)
levels.interview: Level 4 — Bank interview answers (facts the DBD does not hold)

dbd.objectivesHint: One objective per line; a leading number is kept, e.g. "1. To operate…"
dbd.shareholdersHint: One per line: name | nationality | shares
dbd.fileHint: PDF, up to 30 MB per file
dbd.interviewHint: The bank asks these too, but no DBD document answers them. Enter the answers the company prepared; they feed the study cards, quiz, exam and the readiness interview.

interviewFields.nature_of_business: What the business does (in plain words)
interviewFields.products_services: Products or services it plans to sell
interviewFields.account_purpose: Why does the company need a bank account?
interviewFields.client_origin: Where and how customers are found
interviewFields.revenue_basis: What the revenue figure is based on
interviewFields.first_incoming_funds: Where the first money into the account comes from, and why
interviewFields.promptpay_qr_purpose: Why the company needs PromptPay / QR
interviewFields.customer_profile: What kind of customers (type, in Thailand or abroad)
interviewFields.transaction_details: How past sales were paid (method, typical amounts)

index.label: Search index
index.hint: Documents are read five pages at a time in the background (about a minute per run); reload to refresh the status.
index.removeUnavailable: The document was kept: the search index (Pinecone) is unreachable, so its vectors could not be removed first. Try again later.

ask.title: Ask the documents
ask.hint: Answers come only from the uploaded documents, with the page — use it to check what was read.
ask.placeholder: e.g. What is the registered capital? / Who holds shares?

errors.not_indexed: The documents are not indexed yet — wait until the status is "Ready"

ask.noAnswer: No model answer available; showing the passages found

dbd.deferredFill: The documents are too long to read in one pass; they are being read in the background and the fields will fill in when the index status is "Ready" (reload to see them).
dbd.readingQueued: The documents are being read in the background (about 1–3 minutes); reload the page to see the filled fields.
dbd.readingFailed: The documents could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or click "Read the document again".
dbd.answersMissing: Still to fill in before this record can be confirmed: {fields}
dbd.legacyHint: Written before the new evaluations; kept exactly as written and not used by them.

interviewFieldsAlt.client_origin: Where and how customers will be found
interviewFieldsAlt.customer_profile: What kind of customers are expected
interviewFieldsAlt.main_suppliers: How products will be sourced (no regular suppliers yet)
interviewFieldsAlt.revenue_basis: What the expected revenue is based on

statusFacts.hint: These decide how some questions are asked (for example about expected rather than existing customers). They are never guessed.

address.title: Registered address (as read against Thai geography)

status.partial: Partly resolved — check the printed address

issues.province_not_found: The province could not be found
issues.district_not_found: The district could not be found in that province
issues.subdistrict_not_found: The subdistrict could not be found in that district
issues.postcode_mismatch: The printed postcode does not match the subdistrict

address.postcodeFromGeography: The postcode was not printed; it is the subdistrict's.
address.notStoredYet: Shown from the printed address; it is stored with the next save.

category.title: Business category
category.needsReview: Needs a person: the best match is {candidate} ({confidence}% confidence)

errors.no_text: Write what the business does first
errors.failed: Automatic mapping failed; choose one or map again

coverage.title: Evaluation readiness
coverage.introCompany: Company-level concepts that can already be asked about this company: 29 of the MCQ and 12 of the bank interview. Each learner's own concepts are checked on their page.
coverage.introAssignment: Everything this learner will be asked: all 30 MCQ concepts and all 13 bank-interview concepts, their own included.
coverage.allReady: Every concept has what it needs.

facts.account_purpose: Why the company needs an account
facts.holder_name: Learner's name as in the DBD documents

dbd.confirmedAutomatically: Confirmed automatically: every fact was read from the documents and the four details were given.

versions.title: Training versions
versions.intro: Learners study and are evaluated on a frozen copy of these facts. A save that changes them makes a new version; nobody moves to it until a person moves them.
versions.none: No version yet — the record has not been confirmed.
versions.complete: Complete at company scope: every one of the 29 MCQ and 12 bank-interview concepts resolves.
versions.behind: {count, plural, =0 {Every learner is on this version.} one {# learner is on an older version.} other {# learners are on older versions.}}

assignment.title: Assigned company
assignment.eligibilityPending: Eligibility date pending — the certificate issue date is missing

errors.already-assigned: This learner already has an active assignment
errors.not-confirmed: Only confirmed records can be assigned

questions.title: Question bank
questions.approvalHint: Approval requires Thai, English and Chinese versions. Only approved, active questions are served.
questions.placeholderHint: Placeholders you can use (distractor variants after a pipe):
questions.fillMissingHint: Missing: {languages}. Translated from the existing language, keeping '{...}' variables and options unchanged.

fillErrors.provider: The AI provider returned an error. Try again.
fillErrors.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid result. Try again.
fillErrors.no_material: Write at least one language first

settings.title: Policy settings
settings.intro: These values drive the business rules (policy_config). Every change is audited with the admin who made it.

bank_eligibility_days.label: Days before the bank stage opens
bank_eligibility_days.help: Counted from the certificate issue date (BR-002, default 45). Changing it recomputes every learner's date.

bank_access_expiry_days.label: Days the bank stage stays open
bank_access_expiry_days.help: Counted from the opening date; blank = never expires

exam_retry_wait_hours.label: Hours to wait before retaking the exam

exam_pass_rule.label: Exam pass rule
exam_pass_rule.help: Which result decides the passed status

require_exam_pass_for_name_card.label: Require exam pass for the name card
require_exam_pass_for_name_card.help: When on, learners must pass the exam before creating a card

require_exam_pass_for_interview.label: Exam pass required before the readiness interview
require_exam_pass_for_interview.help: When on, a learner must pass the exam before starting the readiness interview.

study_completion_tracking.label: Study completion rule
study_completion_tracking.help: Count a card when viewed, or only when the learner marks it completed

appointment_hours_start.label: Appointment hours start
appointment_hours_start.help: First bookable hour of the day, Bangkok time, e.g. 9

appointment_hours_end.label: Appointment hours end
appointment_hours_end.help: The hour bookings stop, Bangkok time, e.g. 16 (the last slot ends by then)

appointment_slot_minutes.label: Slot length (minutes)
appointment_slot_minutes.help: How long each slot lasts, e.g. 60

appointment_notice_hours.label: Notice (hours)
appointment_notice_hours.help: How many hours before a slot a learner may still book or cancel

appointment_holidays.label: Bank holidays
appointment_holidays.help: The Bank of Thailand's public holidays, one ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) per line, substitution days included; add next year's list each December

business_category_min_confidence_percent.label: Business category: minimum confidence to accept automatically (%)
business_category_min_confidence_percent.help: At or above this, the mapped category is used without review; below it the suggestion waits for a manager or the Owner.

generate.title: Generate questions with AI
generate.intro: Questions are grounded in the DBD company certificate. Pick a reference certificate and a count; the model drafts multiple-choice questions in Thai, English and Chinese, using variables so each learner is asked about their own company. Everything stays a draft until you review and approve it.
generate.fakeNotice: Test mode: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so sample questions are generated instead.
generate.materialHint: Optional extra material for general-knowledge questions: tick study cards, paste text, or upload a file.
generate.pastedHint: Paste notes, lesson content, or your existing draft questions…
generate.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD (max 20 MB)
generate.templateCount: Of which ask facts from the learner's certificate
generate.templateHint: Defaults to all; the rest test understanding of the document itself.
generate.focusHint: e.g. emphasise what bank officers ask
generate.generating: Generating… (about 1–3 minutes, keep this page open)

errors.not_configured: AI is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). Contact an admin.
errors.provider: The AI provider returned an error. Try again.
errors.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid result. Try again.
errors.no_material: Pick a study card, paste text, or upload a file
errors.nothing_produced: No question passed validation. Try again.

generate.referenceHint: The AI reads this certificate's particulars (and its PDF when uploaded) to ask about the real facts, but never copies its values into a question — every question uses variables so each learner is asked about their own company.

role.title: The learner's role in the company
role.hint: The bank asks "how many shares do you hold?", "what is your position?" — the portal needs to know who this learner is in the DBD documents.
role.holderName: Name as in the DBD documents
role.holderHint: Pick from the directors/shareholders or type it; used to match the learner's shareholding.

managers.title: Managers
managers.suspendHint: Suspending a manager stops their sign-in. Their learners keep studying and their companies stay visible to you.

interviews.title: Readiness interviews
interviews.intro: Every interview held by a learner of your team, with its verdict and the officer’s assessment of each answer.

appointments.title: Bank appointments
appointments.intro: Your team's upcoming appointments by day; block the hours you cannot take.

home.intro: Pick a section to manage. A manager sees their own team only.

businessCategories.title: Business categories
businessCategories.intro: The controlled list the automatic mapping chooses from and the MCQ draws business distractors from. Retire a category by switching it off; keys never change.
businessCategories.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and _; permanent once created.

errors.invalid: Check the key and fill every label

study.title: Study material
study.notAvailable: Not available in this language yet
study.openPdf: Open PDF in a new tab
study.pdfMissing: The PDF for this language has not been uploaded yet.

evidence.title: From your documents
evidence.hint: The actual text of your company's DBD documents for this topic — compare it with your prepared answers.

study.intro: {count} cards on what the bank will ask, each filled with your own company's facts.

quiz.title: Evaluation quiz
quiz.intro: Practice questions about your company and the process. You see whether each answer is right immediately, with an explanation, and a full review at the end.

errors.no_assignment: No company is assigned to you yet.
errors.no_questions: No questions are available for your company yet.
errors.no_version: Your company's training facts are not ready yet. Ask your manager to check the record.

quiz.jumpNext: Go to the next unanswered question

exam.title: Exam
exam.intro: {count} questions. You will not see whether an answer is right until you submit. Passing mark: {passingMark}%.
exam.noFeedbackNote: Answers are saved as you go; results are shown only after you submit.
exam.resultNote: Questions marked ✗ were answered incorrectly; the green option is the correct answer and the struck-through one is what you chose.

errors.max_attempts: You have used all allowed attempts.
errors.retry_wait: Please wait before retrying the exam.
errors.no_assignment: No company is assigned to you yet.
errors.no_questions: No exam questions are available for your company yet.
errors.no_version: Your company's training facts are not ready yet. Ask your manager to check the record.

exam.passedNext: You passed. The readiness interview is now open.
exam.notPassedNext: Not passed this time. Review the answers below and try again when you are ready.

interview.title: Readiness interview
interview.intro: An AI bank officer interviews you in Thai, as on the day: questions about your company, checked against the certificate, and a verdict on whether you are ready. Repeat as often as you like.
interview.thaiOnly: The interview is entirely in Thai.

errors.not_open: The interview is not open yet.
errors.no_assignment: No company has been assigned to you.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.expired: The interview sat idle too long. Please start again.
errors.no_facts: The company record has nothing to verify yet. Ask your manager.
errors.no_version: Your company's training facts are not ready yet. Ask your manager to check the record.

closeReason.too_many_evasions: Closed after the third evaded answer.
closeReason.turn_limit: The interview reached its message limit.
closeReason.abandoned: The interview sat idle for over 30 minutes and was abandoned.

appointment.title: Bank appointment
appointment.intro: Pick the day and time you will go to the bank with your manager. Open every day except bank holidays, one person per slot.

booked.title: Your appointment
booked.cancelHint: You can cancel until {hours} hours before

errors.already_booked: You already have an appointment. Cancel it to pick another.
errors.slot_taken: Someone just took that slot. Please pick another.
errors.too_late: Too close to the appointment to cancel. Ask your manager.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

nameCard.intro: One design for every company, filled from your company record plus the name and phone number you enter. Preview, download the PDF, or send it to Telegram.
nameCard.sentNoDestinations: No Telegram destination is configured yet.

errors.no_assignment: No company is assigned to you yet.
errors.exam_required: Pass the exam first to create your name card.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid Thai mobile number.
